demos.name: PingCLI Lab
demos.description: Watch an admin automate PingOne with Ping CLI: 14 allow-listed, read-only pingcli commands streamed to the browser, an install -> init -> auth -> run guide, and an easy-read table. Mock plays canned output offline; Real runs pinned pingcli 1.2.0 against your own environment.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7806). Docker: docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Mock needs no tenant and no credentials. Real: PINGONE_ENVIRONMENT_ID, PINGONE_REGION, PINGONE_CLIENT_ID, PINGONE_CLIENT_SECRET in ~/Development/.env (host) or passed through compose (Docker). Derived from the AI-DEMO2 /pingcli page. Catalog id D126 (owner, 2026-11-09).
